newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average rallied 22.36 points to close at 6,521.70 on Friday as long-term interest rates fell and the holiday shopping season got off to a strong start.

* Leaders of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) have agreed to map out an "ASEAN vision for the year 2020," a guideline for direction beyond the ASEAN Free Trade Area in 2003, Indonesia's Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said.

* The Jakarta composite index rose 1.51 points, or 0.25 percent, to close at 613.01 points on Friday on the back of bargain-hunting in heavyweight Telkom and several medium-sized counters, including banking stocks.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed on Monday on a lack of fresh leads, but bargain-hunting was expected in some big-capitalised stocks.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,345.00/45.25 in early trading against the opening of 2,344.50/45.50.
* Indofood on an announcement that it plans to acquire its principal distributor Indomarco early next year.
* Lippo Securities on news it posted a net profit of 26.12 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 8.52 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
* Second-liner Hotel Prapatan on market talk of a possible rights issue.
